intent: Evolve the already-existing default-branch research-orchestration invocation adapter so CAP-0007 research-orchestration/v2 can execute an exact requested branch/head from a prepared transport-neutral material root in real PostgreSQL runtime. Reuse the generic broker rather than creating or dispatching a semiconductor-specific orchestration path; Grounded Evidence remains CAP-0002-owned and no Fact/Judgment promotion is implied.
rationale: CAP-0007 already owns campaign-agnostic execution-stage composition, exact acceptance gates and portable receipts, and its extension seam explicitly routes invocation adapters through the same orchestration contracts rather than campaign-specific workflow logic. Repository history shows a default-branch issue-trigger broker already exists and has been reused after workflow-visibility failures. The semiconductor-specific workflow was therefore an invocation routing mistake, not evidence for a new owner.
